note: Bound-m campaign 2 (TASK-c2.md). Every limit under engines applies to one run = one (arm, seed). Money, token, reasoning and timeout caps live in broker-config.json. Development = campaign 1 frozen development.json by reference (hash in frozen/manifest.json); validation (c1 holdout m=11) and holdout (m=12 + fresh m=11) are never loaded by an engine. Covered by the approval hash: python -m integrations.bound_c2 approval-hash.
seed_note: Campaign 1 EvoX finalist (finalists/sources/evox.py, sha256 1031149e48768fd67907350b9f7fc1ef207a7eb33533fedbdb1466d2618d2e9a) with only its module docstring rewritten to describe its own construction (BEST-GEPA-CONSTRUCTION.md section 6); the code after the docstring is AST-identical.
seed_semantics: SkyDiscover search.database.random_seed and GEPA EngineConfig.seed = run seed. The sequential control records the seed; the provider request carries no seed field, so its seeds differ only by sampling.
max_requests_note: Pool = 360 contacts (broker-config contact_ceiling_formula at max_usd 60). Sub-cap 30 per run, 12 x 30 = 360 <= 360. Iterations 30 per run = sub-cap, so a run can make 30 proposals (EvoX spends about 2 contacts on startup probes). GEPA max_evals covers 30 + 31 * 36 = 1146 metric calls plus final checks.

lines: Hint (research group's m=8 proof, REVERSAL-OBSTACLE.md section 2): of the 4088 reversal-orbit families (rotations of 8..1, all masks), 4054 closed with one mixture (criterion 7) and 34 needed piecewise tree certificates split on block lengths.
The m=8 analogue of the reversal with zeros in the leading and trailing gap closed with two words weighted 1/2: B 43 with slopes (5,4) and B 41 with slopes (7,6).
This contract scores one mixture only, so return complementary words whose average keeps every slope <= m-2 (mirrored crossing profiles), not many near-copies of one best word.
reversal_hint.rule: Enabled because REVERSAL-OBSTACLE.md exists and states (section 2) that 34 of 4088 m=8 reversal-orbit families needed piecewise tree certificates. Every hint fact comes from m=8 data; nothing from the validation or holdout sets. Re-checked after the 2026-09-25 addendum (deferred (11,2) table): section 2 unchanged, hint text unchanged.

finalize.selection: per (arm, seed): among accepted candidates (seed, every source with a full development evaluation in the run's evaluation trace, the verified best, and for GEPA its candidate pool), the finalist maximizes validation (certified, combined_score); ties by source sha256 ascending. Development scores are not used.
finalize.determinism: bound_evaluator.determinism_check on the first 20 screen families for every finalist
finalize.claim_rule: An engine claims progress only if its finalists' mean holdout certified count beats control (b) and the seed across seeds; single-seed wins are reported, not claimed.

order: Seeds interleaved: s1 gepa, sequential, adaevolve, evox; then s2; then s3 (run-campaign-c2.sh). A HALT file in this directory, a refused start, a FIRST_PROMPT_MISMATCH, or 2 runs ending INCOMPLETE/BROKER_STOPPED stop the runner.

word_pool.admission: valid words of the seed and of every candidate that receives a full development evaluation (promising or final); for GEPA, of every candidate once it has been evaluated on all 30 screen (valset) families
word_pool.pruning: Pareto on (B, beta_0..beta_{k-1}); dominated words never lower an LP optimum
word_pool.pool_gain: families certified by the exact LP over pool + candidate words minus those certified by the pool alone, over the evaluated families (bound_evaluator.classify)
word_pool.selection: standalone certified counts only; the pool is packet and report information
